questions.stem: Who is going to be your new baseball coach?

options.B: We often play baseball after school.
options.D: We won't go to the beach tonight.

questions.explain:
coach: 教練
be into: 熱衷於、很喜歡
have no idea: 不知道
解析：題目詢問「誰將擔任你們的新棒球教練？」，是用 Who 詢問人選。答案選C，以「我不知道」合理解答。選項 A 和 B 故意重複題目出現的 baseball 設下答非所問的字面陷阱；選項 D 的 beach 則是無關干擾。

questions.stem: Is your father a professional photographer?

options.A: Yes, he is a college professor.
options.C: Yes, he is a professional golfer
options.D: No, he is not so old.

questions.explain:
professional: 專業的
photographer: 攝影師
amateur: 業餘人士
解析：題意問「你父親是專業攝影師嗎？」選項B的 amateur（業餘愛好者）與 professional 恰好相對，回答合乎邏輯，故答案選B。選項A用發音相近的 professor（教授）混淆；選項C偷換職業成 golfer（高爾夫球員）；選項D答非所問扯到年齡，皆為常見的干擾陷阱。

questions.stem: Do you have a table available for two?

options.A: No, we don't sell furniture here.
options.C: No, I'm not available this afternoon.

questions.explain:
available: 有空的、可用的
table for two: 兩人的位子
this way, please: 這邊請
解析：題意為在餐廳詢問「有兩人的空位嗎？」，答案選D，服務生回答「有，這邊請」最符合情境。干擾項A誤將table當一般家具，B把two誤解為兩點鐘，C誤將詢問空位當作個人是否有空，皆為字面陷阱。

questions.stem: How was your date with Betty last night?

options.D: It was arranged by a friend.

questions.explain:
date: 約會
have a great time: 玩得很開心
arrange: 安排
解析：題意為「你昨晚跟貝蒂約會如何？」，主要詢問約會的過程與感受。A回答「我們玩得很開心」正面回應狀況，故答案選A。選項B與C分別提及生日與年齡，完全答非所問；選項D「由朋友安排」是在說明牽線方式，而非回答約會進行得如何。

questions.stem: Which country has the largest population?
questions.explain:
population: 人口
largest: 最大的、最多的
解析：題意問「哪個國家的人口最多？」答案選C。干擾選項A俄羅斯是國土面積最大而非人口最多，B澳洲與D美國人口皆少於中國，此題容易將人口（population）與面積大小混淆。

questions.stem: Speaking of dance, why do you like the waltz so much?
questions.explain:
Speaking of: 談到、說起
waltz: 華爾滋
graceful: 優雅的
解析：題目問為何這麼喜歡華爾滋，D表示「因為看起來很優雅」，符合喜愛的原因，答案選D。干擾項B的 war dance 是利用 waltz 的相近發音設下的語音陷阱；A將舞蹈誤指為地點；C的 ordinary（平凡）則不合喜歡的邏輯。

questions.stem: Is the course very difficult for you?

options.A: No, my main course is not served yet.

questions.explain:
course: 課程
drive someone nuts: 使某人抓狂
main course: 主餐、主菜
解析：題目詢問這門課程是否很難，答案選D。drive someone nuts 表示難到讓人抓狂，符合語境。選項A的主菜與選項B的高爾夫球場，都是利用 course 的一字多義設下的字面陷阱；選項C指容易討好，與題意完全無關。

questions.stem: Which of the following is the smallest group of soldiers?
questions.explain:
squad: 班
platoon: 排
battalion: 營
解析：題意詢問何者是最小的士兵編制單位。軍事編制由小到大依序為班、排、連、營，因此最小的是班，答案選A。選項B platoon（排）、C company（連）、D battalion（營）的規模都大於班，屬於編制層級大小混淆的干擾選項。

questions.stem: Do I need to find a tutor?

options.A: No, I don't need your help.
options.C: No, I can't find it anywhere.

questions.explain:
tutor: 家教、課外指導老師
extra help: 額外的協助
解析：題意為「我需要找家教嗎？」。家教的功能就是提供額外的課業協助，故答案選B。干擾選項中，A混淆主詞對象且文不對題；C利用find製造找失物的字面陷阱；D前後矛盾，表現優異通常不需要再找家教。

questions.stem: Is the boss in a good mood?

options.A: I think so. He looks quite happy
options.C: I think so. He looks very serious.
options.D: No, he's not choosy about food.

questions.explain:
in a good mood: 心情好
serious: 嚴肅的
choosy: 挑剔的
解析：題目問老闆心情好嗎？A「我想是，他看起來挺開心的」語意最相符，故答案選A。B與D利用與mood發音相近的food設聽力陷阱；C雖回答正面，後句卻說神情很嚴肅，前後語意矛盾。

questions.stem: Are you going to pack your suitcase tonight or tomorrow morning?

options.A: No, I don't need to buy a new suitcase.
options.B: Yes, I plan to go backpacking around the world.
options.C: I'll buy a new suitcase tomorrow morning.

questions.explain:
pack: 打包；整理行李
suitcase: 行李箱
had better: 最好
解析：題目問「你打算今晚還是明早整理行李？」，此為 or 的二選一選擇疑問句，不可用 Yes 或 No 回答，故答案選D。選項A、B用 No/Yes 回答是典型文法陷阱，且B以 backpacking 混淆 pack；C答非所問提到買新行李箱。

questions.stem: Are you a fan of Lady Gaga?

options.A: No, she is not a fashion designer
options.B: Yes, she models herself on Madonna.
options.C: No, she doesn't like the stage.

questions.explain:
fan of: ...的粉絲
idol: 偶像
model oneself on: 仿效
解析：題目詢問「你是女神卡卡的粉絲嗎？」，答案選D，回答「是的，她是我的偶像」，直接且正面回應問題。選項A扯到時裝設計師、B談論她模仿他人、C稱她不喜歡舞台，皆非針對個人是否為其粉絲的合理回應，屬於偏離主題的干擾選項。

questions.stem: How did your math test go?
questions.explain:
How did ... go?: ...進展得如何？
math test: 數學測驗
解析：題目詢問「你的數學考試考得如何？」片語 How did it go 用來問事情的狀況或結果，因此回答考得還可以的答案選B。選項A與C落入將 go 解釋為實體「前往某地」的字面陷阱；選項D扯到身分則是答非所問。

questions.stem: What kind of shirt are you looking for?

options.A: I'm going to a wedding, so it must be formal.
options.B: I'm looking for a bunch of keys.
options.C: No, this shirt doesn't fit me.
options.D: Yes, that pair of shoes is a good choice.

questions.explain:
look for: 尋找
formal: 正式的
解析：題目詢問「你想找哪種襯衫？」，為特殊疑問句。選項A說明要去參加婚禮所以需要正式襯衫，符合語境，故答案選A。選項B利用重複字looking for設下找鑰匙的字面陷阱；選項C與D用Yes或No回答What開頭的問句在文法上錯誤，且D還離題提到鞋子。

questions.stem: Where can I get some organic vegetables?
questions.explain:
organic vegetables: 有機蔬菜
flea market: 跳蚤市場
drugstore: 藥局
解析：題目詢問哪裡可以買到有機蔬菜。supermarket（超級市場）主要販售生鮮蔬果及各類食材，故答案選D。干擾選項A是藥局、B是販售二手舊物的跳蚤市場、C是家具行，皆非購買新鮮蔬菜的常規場所。

questions.stem: I'm new here. Can you recommend a good eating place?

options.A: I can't remember those good old days.
options.B: There is an excellent Chinese restaurant across the street.
options.D: There is a time limit, so please hurry.

questions.explain:
recommend: 推薦
eating place: 餐廳、用餐地點
across the street: 在街對面
解析：題意為「我是新來的，你能推薦好吃的餐廳嗎？」。答案選B，推薦了對街優秀的中餐廳，符合提問。選項A用發音與recommend相近的remember設下聽力陷阱；C表示寧可在家吃、D提到時間限制，皆答非所問。

questions.stem: Where can I try on these pants?

options.B: In cash or by credit card.
options.D: In the fitting room over there.

questions.explain:
try on: 試穿
fitting room: 試衣間
解析：題目詢問「我在哪裡可以試穿這件褲子？」，Where詢問地點，fitting room是試衣間，因此答案選D。干擾選項A回答時間（When），B回答付款方式（How），C意為在聚光燈下，皆不符合詢問試穿地點的語境。

questions.stem: May I look at that watch, please?

options.B: You don't need it, do you?
options.C: No, it doesn't cost that much.

questions.explain:
look at: 查看、注視
watch: 手錶
Here it is: 在這裡、這就給您
解析：題意為禮貌請求「我可以看一下那只手錶嗎？」，A選項回答「當然可以，這就拿給您」最符合情境，故答案選A。干擾項D是將名詞「手錶」混淆為動詞被「監視」的字面陷阱；C扯到價格、B反問不需要皆答非所問。

questions.stem: Where did they go on vacation?

options.A: They really should take a vacation.
options.B: They went to eat Mexican food.
options.C: They went to school after the summer vacation.
options.D: They went to a hot spring resort.

questions.explain:
go on vacation: 去度假
hot spring resort: 溫泉度假村
解析：題目詢問「他們去哪裡度假？」，Where 詢問地點，故答案選D（去了溫泉度假村）。選項A與C是利用同字 vacation 的字面干擾，未回答地點；選項B 則是回答吃了什麼，皆不合題意。

questions.stem: Who is your immediate superior, Major Gibson?
questions.explain:
immediate superior: 直屬長官
Major: 少校
Colonel: 上校
解析：題目詢問吉布森少校的直屬長官是誰。軍階中高於少校的只有上校，因此答案選A。干擾選項B中尉、C士官及D士兵的階級皆低於少校，屬於部屬而非長官，為階級判斷陷阱。

questions.stem: Hey, Lily, how are you doing?

options.A: I'm not doing anything at all.

questions.explain:
How are you doing: 你好嗎、最近如何
Not bad: 還不錯
None of your business: 不關你的事
解析：題目為常見問候「你好嗎？」，答案選B「還不錯，那你呢？」最符合社交禮儀。A選項為字面陷阱，誤把問候當成詢問「正在做什麼」；C是回答去向，D則過於粗魯，皆不符語境。

questions.stem: Why does your hair look so neat?

options.A: I think I need some fresh air
options.B: I like meat, but I hate vegetables.
options.C: I just came back from a beauty shop.

questions.explain:
neat: 整齊的
beauty shop: 美容院
解析：題意問「為什麼你的頭髮看起來這麼整齊？」剛從美容院回來合理解釋了原因，故答案選C。干擾選項A用air混淆hair、B用meat混淆neat，皆為ALCPT聽力測驗常見的同韻音近陷阱。

questions.stem: Has Tom remained single all these years?

options.A: No, he's been married for two years.
options.B: Yes, he's just hit a single.
options.C: No, he asked the bartender to make it a double.
options.D: Yes, he's been a singer all these years.

questions.explain:
remain: 保持；維持
single: 單身的
hit a single: 擊出一壘安打
解析：題目詢問湯姆這些年是否一直維持單身。針對感情狀況提問，回答已結婚兩年最符合邏輯，答案選A。選項B的一壘安打與C的酒吧雙份均為 single 一詞多義的字面陷阱；選項D則是利用 singer 與 single 發音相近的聽力干擾。

questions.stem: Did you enjoy the concert last night?

options.A: No, I'm not concerned about that.
options.B: Yes, I went to the movies last night.

questions.explain:
concert: 音樂會
awesome: 棒極了
concerned: 擔心的
解析：問句詢問昨晚音樂會是否玩得開心。選項D正面回應感受，故答案選D。選項A的concerned與C的convenient為字音相近的混淆陷阱；B提及去電影院則是答非所問。

questions.stem: How do you usually go to work?

options.B: I usually take a walk after supper.
options.C: I usually get to work at 8:30.

questions.explain:
go to work: 去上班
take the subway: 搭乘捷運
解析：題意為「你通常如何去上班？」，用How詢問通勤方式。A選項回答搭捷運最符合語意，故答案選A。干擾選項C回答抵達時間，應用When提問；B是晚飯後散步，D是起床時間，皆與交通方式無關。

questions.stem: Excuse me. Have we met before?

options.A: Yes, we met them about a week ago.
options.C: I was your classmate in high school. Remember?

questions.explain:
Excuse me: 不好意思
meet before: 以前見過面
classmate: 同學
解析：問句意為「不好意思，我們以前見過面嗎？」答案選C，回答點出兩人曾在高中同窗，符合情境。A與B代名詞誤用they/them；D則是利用Excuse的另一字義「藉口」所設的字面陷阱。

questions.stem: Do you have any hobbies?

options.A: Yes, I've never been happier in my life.
options.B: No, happiness is not easy to find.
options.C: Yes, I collect coins from around the world.
options.D: No, I don't like those hippies.

questions.explain:
hobby: 嗜好、興趣
collect coins: 收集硬幣
hippie: 嬉皮
解析：題意詢問「你有什麼嗜好嗎？」，答案選C，因為收集各國硬幣是具體的休閒興趣。選項A、B的happy與happiness，以及選項D的hippies，都是利用發音與hobby相近的字詞所設計的聽力干擾陷阱，與題意無關。

questions.stem: Have you ever been to Spain?

options.A: Yes, I'm willing to spend money.
options.C: Yes, I'm going to Paris tomorrow.

questions.explain:
have been to: 曾經去過
be willing to: 願意
Spanish: 西班牙語
解析：題目詢問「你曾去過西班牙嗎？」是問旅遊經驗，答案選B，以否定回答沒去過該地最合邏輯。選項A是用發音相近的 spend 設下聽力陷阱；C 提到去巴黎且是未來式，答非所問；D 則是把地名延伸到語言 Spanish，偏離詢問拜訪經驗的核心。

questions.stem: Jack worked his way through college.

options.A: Jack graduated from college with honors.
options.B: Jack did not graduate from college.
options.C: Jack walked to school for four years.
options.D: Jack worked part-time to finish college.

questions.explain:
work one's way through: 自力工讀完成學業
graduate from: 從...畢業
解析：題意為傑克半工半讀完成大學。work one's way through college 指靠打工賺學費讀完大學，故答案選D。選項C的 walked 是利用 worked 的音近陷阱；選項A的榮譽畢業與B的未畢業皆不符題意。

questions.stem: Michael is crazy about football.

options.A: Michael is a very good football player
options.B: Michael is full of crazy ideas about football.
options.C: Michael hates to watch football games.

questions.explain:
be crazy about: 非常狂熱、極喜愛
football: 足球、美式橄欖球
解析：題意為麥可對足球非常狂熱。片語 be crazy about 表示極度喜愛某事物，語意等同 like very much，故答案選D。選項B是用字面上的 crazy（瘋狂的點子）設下聽力陷阱；選項A過度推論他是優秀球員；選項C的 hates（討厭）則與原意完全相反。

questions.stem: The hostages have been set free.

options.A: The hostages have been physically abused.

questions.explain:
hostage: 人質
set free: 釋放
release: 釋放
解析：題意為人質已經被釋放。片語 set free 等同於 release，因此答案選B。主要干擾項D的 rescued 是指被外部軍警營救，但題幹僅強調獲得自由或釋放；A選項 abused（受虐待）與C選項 executed（被處決）則與原意完全不符。

questions.stem: My older sister and I used to fight a lot.

options.A: We often had arguments in the past.

questions.explain:
used to: 過去常常
fight: 爭吵；打架
argument: 爭吵；爭論
解析：題意為「我姊姊和我過去常吵架」。used to 表示過去習慣，fight 在此指言語爭吵，與 had arguments in the past 意思相同，故答案選A。選項C相處融洽與句意相反；選項D的 frightening（嚇唬）則是發音與拼字相近的混淆陷阱。

questions.stem: Well, I'm all ears.

options.A: I am ready to listen to what you want to say.
options.B: I am an old man now.
options.D: I am still young and energetic.

questions.explain:
all ears: 全神貫注地聽、洗耳恭聽
be fond of: 喜愛
energetic: 精力充沛的
解析：題幹「I'm all ears」為常見慣用語，字面是「我全是耳朵」，實際意思是「洗耳恭聽、準備好聽你說了」，故答案選A。選項B與D提及年齡及精力毫無關聯；選項C提到喜愛音樂則是利用ears（耳朵聽聲音）設計的聯想陷阱，皆非正確題意。

questions.stem: Let's go grab a bite, Henry.

options.A: Let's get something to eat, Henry

questions.explain:
grab a bite: 吃點東西
seize the opportunity: 把握機會
解析：題幹 grab a bite 是常見生活俚語，意為隨便吃點東西，故答案選A。選項B利用 a bit 與 bite 的發音及拼字相似設計干擾陷阱；選項C去釣魚及選項D把握機會皆與原意無關。

questions.stem: I hope I can get back in shape soon.

options.A: I hope I can have my revenge soon.
options.B: I hope I can regain fitness soon.
options.C: I hope I can get a refund soon.
options.D: I hope I can return home soon.

questions.explain:
get back in shape: 恢復體態、體能
regain fitness: 恢復體能
解析：題幹 get back in shape 指恢復健康或體態，與 regain fitness 意思相同，故答案選B。干擾選項A的報仇（revenge）、C的退款（refund）及D的返家，皆是利用字首 re- 的單字設下語意無關的陷阱。

questions.stem: Please excuse me for a moment.

options.A: Sorry, I did not mean what I said.
options.B: Please excuse me for my mistake.
options.C: Sorry, I need to be away for a few minutes.
options.D: Please excuse me for my rudeness.

questions.explain:
excuse: 原諒、准許離開
for a moment: 片刻、一會兒
be away: 離開
解析：題意為「請容我失陪一下」，為暫時離開現場的禮貌用語，與C選項意思相符，故答案選C。選項A、B、D皆為字面陷阱，將excuse誤解為對失言、錯誤或無禮舉止道歉，忽略了for a moment是指暫離一會兒。

questions.stem: He is such a bonehead!

options.B: He eats a lot of meat.

questions.explain:
bonehead: 笨蛋、傻瓜
stubborn: 固執的
解析：題意為「他真是個笨蛋！」。bonehead 是美語俚語，指愚蠢、不聰明的人，故答案選A。選項B由 bone 骨頭字面聯想到吃肉，選項C聯想到體格強壯，選項D意為固執，皆為字面臆測的干擾選項。

questions.stem: We need more cooperation than competition.

options.A: Cooperation and competition are equally important to us.
options.B: Cooperation is more important to us than competition.
options.C: Competition is more important to us than cooperation.
options.D: Competition and cooperation are not important to us.

questions.explain:
cooperation: 合作
competition: 競爭
equally: 同樣地、平等地
解析：題意為「比起競爭，我們更需要合作」，代表合作比競爭更重要，故答案選B。干擾選項C將兩者的重要性完全顛倒；選項A誤指兩者同等重要（equally）；選項D則說兩者都不重要，皆與原句核心語意不符。

questions.stem: Don't get lost in cyberspace.

options.A: Don't get addicted to the Internet.
options.C: Don't get lost in big cities.

questions.explain:
cyberspace: 網路世界、虛擬空間
get lost in: 沉溺於、迷失於
get addicted to: 對...沉迷成癮
解析：題幹意為「別在網路世界迷失自我」，cyberspace 即網路空間，get lost in 在此引申為過度沉溺，故答案選A。選項C是字面陷阱，將 get lost 誤導為在實體城市中迷路；選項B與D的幽浮與奇蹟則與題意完全無關。

questions.stem: The scenery in the village is breathtaking.

options.A: The scenery in the village is artificial.
options.B: The scenery in the village is already spoiled.
options.C: The scenery in the village is very beautiful.
options.D: The scenery in the village is very ordinary.

questions.explain:
scenery: 風景
breathtaking: 令人屏息的、極美的
artificial: 人工的、人造的
解析：題意為「村莊的風景美得令人屏息」。breathtaking形容景色極為壯觀美麗，與very beautiful同義，故答案選C。選項A人工的、B被破壞的、D普通的皆與原意不符或相反，為語意陷阱。

questions.stem: Tea is an essential part of my daily life.

options.A: I drink tea on a daily basis.
options.B: I believe drinking tea is good for health.
options.C: I drink tea only once in a while.
options.D: I prefer drinking tea to drinking coffee.

questions.explain:
essential: 不可或缺的
on a daily basis: 每天
once in a while: 偶爾
解析：題意為「茶是我日常生活不可或缺的一部分」，代表天天喝茶。選項A以 on a daily basis（每天）改寫 daily life，語意最相符，故答案選A。干擾選項C意為「偶爾」，與題意相反；B講有益健康、D講偏好咖啡，皆為題目未提及的過度推論。

questions.stem: It must have cost him an arm and a leg.

options.A: It must have cost him a lot of money.
options.B: It must have had an accident.
options.C: It must have cost him a lot of effort.
options.D: It must have gotten into a big trouble.

questions.explain:
cost an arm and a leg: 花大筆錢、極昂貴
must have + p.p.: 一定已經
解析：題意為「這肯定花了他一大筆錢」。「cost an arm and a leg」為慣用語，意指價格極為昂貴，故答案選A。選項B由手和腿字面聯想成發生意外，C誤導為花費許多努力，皆為字面陷阱。

questions.stem: It's time to hit the sack now.

options.B: It's time to have a meeting now.
options.C: It's time to go to bed now.

questions.explain:
hit the sack: 上床睡覺
go to bed: 就寢
解析：題目中的 hit the sack 是美語極常見的俚語，意思是上床睡覺，同義於 go to bed，故答案選C。選項A工作、B開會、D聊天均與睡覺無關，切勿從 sack（袋子）字面胡亂猜測。

questions.stem: She decided to travel on her own.

options.A: She decided to travel on budget.
options.B: She decided to travel by herself.
options.C: She decided to travel with her own friends.
options.D: She decided to travel by bike.

questions.explain:
on one's own: 獨自一人
by oneself: 獨自、靠自己
on a budget: 預算有限地
解析：題意為「她決定獨自去旅行」。片語 on one's own 與 by oneself 意思完全相同，皆指「獨自一人」，故答案選B。選項C是利用題目重複出現的 own 所設計的字面陷阱；選項A的 budget 與選項D的 bike 則是與題意無關的干擾項。

questions.stem: Our company may need to downsize.

options.A: Our company may need to lay off some workers.
options.B: Our company may need to expand elsewhere.
options.C: Our company may need to hire more employees.
options.D: Our company may need to close down.

questions.explain:
downsize: 縮編、裁員
lay off: 解僱、裁員
close down: 停業、倒閉
解析：題幹表示公司可能需要縮編。downsize 意指縮減組織規模，實務上常透過裁員達成，與 A 選項的 lay off 同義，故答案選A。干擾項 B 的 expand（擴充）與 C 的 hire（僱用）皆與題意完全相反；D 的 close down（倒閉）則是過度推論，組織縮編並不代表公司停業。

questions.stem: Drop by whenever you feel like it.

options.A: Send me a letter whenever you want to do it.
options.B: Send me an e-mail whenever you want to do it.
options.C: Do me a favor whenever you want to do it.
options.D: Pay me a visit whenever you want to do it.

questions.explain:
drop by: 順道拜訪
feel like: 想要
pay someone a visit: 拜訪某人
解析：題意為「你想來的時候隨時順道過來坐坐」。drop by 與選項 D 的 pay a visit 意思相同都是「拜訪」，feel like 等同 want to，故答案選D。選項 A、B 提到寄信或發電子郵件，選項 C 提到請人幫忙，皆扭曲了親自造訪的原意。

questions.stem: I'm just browsing.
questions.explain:
browse: 隨意瀏覽、隨便看看
look around: 四處看看、瀏覽
fool around: 鬼混、胡鬧
解析：題意為「我只是隨便看看」，常用於逛街時回答店員詢問。look around 意思相同，故答案選A。選項B開玩笑、C胡鬧鬼混、D休息一下，皆與單純瀏覽的語意不符，屬於情境動作的干擾項。

questions.stem: In terms of human rights, we speak the same language.

options.A: All people should have the same human rights.
options.B: We should all respect human rights.
options.C: All people know the importance of human rights.
options.D: We share the same ideas about human rights.

questions.explain:
in terms of: 就...而言
human rights: 人權
speak the same language: 想法相同、有共識
解析：題意為「就人權而言，我們有相同看法」。片語 speak the same language 是比喻「想法一致」，因此答案選D。選項A、B、C 僅為人權議題的道德主張或延伸陳述，屬於過度推論的字面干擾陷阱，並非題幹原意的同義代換。

questions.stem: Don't make a pig of yourself.

options.B: Don't act as if you were a cop.

questions.explain:
make a pig of oneself: 大吃大喝、狼吞虎嚥
pig out: 暴飲暴食
解析：題幹「make a pig of yourself」是慣用語，指像豬一樣貪吃，因此答案選A。選項B利用美式俚語將pig聯想為警察（cop）來混淆；選項C與D則是把「豬」延伸為酗酒或愚蠢行為的字面臆測陷阱，皆非正確涵義。

questions.stem: Passive smoking is no less dangerous than smoking itself.

options.A: Passive smoking is not so dangerous as smoking itself.
options.B: Passive smoking is more dangerous than smoking itself.
options.C: Passive smoking is as dangerous as smoking itself.
options.D: Passive smoking is no more dangerous than smoking itself.

questions.explain:
passive smoking: 二手菸
no less than: 不亞於；和...一樣
解析：題意為「二手菸的危險不亞於吸菸本身」。「no less... than」表肯定對等，意即兩者「一樣危險」，故答案選C。選項A表示不如吸菸危險；選項B誤解為比吸菸更危險；選項D則是兩者皆不危險，皆與原句句意不符。

questions.stem: I can't help missing the girl.

options.A: The girl is missing, but I can't do anything to help.
options.B: I failed to meet the girl in person.
options.C: The girl is hiding from me.
options.D: I just can't get the girl out of my mind.

questions.explain:
can't help: 忍不住、無法克制
miss: 想念
get out of one's mind: 忘記、不再去想
解析：題幹意為「我忍不住想念那個女孩」。can't help 加動名詞表示「無法克制」，與 D 選項「無法不想她」語意相符，故答案選D。選項 A 落入字面陷阱，將片語拆解誤譯為「無法幫忙」且將 missing 曲解為「失蹤」；B 與 C 則語意不合。

questions.stem: Jason is an extrovert.
questions.explain:
extrovert: 外向的人
outgoing: 外向開朗的
easygoing: 隨和好相處的
解析：題目說 Jason 是個外向的人。extrovert 與 outgoing 同義，故答案選C。干擾選項 A 害羞與 B 安靜皆為內向者特徵，屬於反義陷阱；選項 D 意為隨和，與 outgoing 拼法及字音相近，容易造成混淆。

questions.stem: Make yourself at home!

options.C: Feel comfortable like when you are in your own home.
options.D: Find a woman, get married and have kids.

questions.explain:
make yourself at home: 請當作自己家、別拘束
comfortable: 輕鬆自在的、舒適的
解析：題幹 Make yourself at home! 是招呼客人的慣用語，意思是「別拘束、像在自己家一樣放鬆」，故答案選C。選項A與B是字面陷阱，將 home 誤解為建造或購買房屋；選項D則是過度聯想為成家立業，皆非本意。

questions.stem: John is the last man to tell a lie.

options.C: He is inclined to tell a lie.
options.D: By no means will he tell a lie.

questions.explain:
the last man to: 最不可能…的人
by no means: 絕不
be inclined to: 傾向於
解析：題幹 the last man to... 意為「最不可能…的人」，指約翰絕不會說謊，故答案選D（by no means 表絕不）。選項A（說謊是其特色）、B（輕易說謊）與C（傾向說謊）皆落入字面陷阱，將否定涵義誤解為他很常說謊。

questions.stem: Mark is a couch potato.

options.A: He is eating potato chips all the time.
options.B: He is lying in bed all the time.
options.C: He is lying on the sofa, watching TV all the time.
options.D: He is working on the computer all the time.

questions.explain:
couch potato: 整天躺在沙發上看電視的人
all the time: 一直、總是
解析：couch potato 為常見俚語，指整天窩在沙發上看電視、不愛運動的懶人，故答案選C。選項A利用字面上的 potato 設計陷阱，誤導成吃洋芋片；選項B躺在床上與選項D操作電腦皆不符合此片語的原意。

questions.stem: I wish I could help you.

options.B: I hope I can help you.
options.C: You certainly are a good help.

questions.explain:
wish could: 但願能夠（與事實相反）
certainly: 確實地、必定
解析：題幹使用 wish 與 could 表達與現在事實相反的假設語氣，隱含「我實際上無法幫你」之意，故答案選D。干擾選項B用 hope 代表未來可能實現的期望，語意不符；A與C則是扭曲了主詞與整句的意思。

questions.stem: M: Who's that girl you were talking to? W: That's Becky. We've been sharing an apartment for years. Q: Who is Becky?

turns.t: Who's that girl you were talking to?
That's Becky. We've been sharing an apartment for years.
Who is Becky?

questions.explain:
share an apartment: 合租公寓
roommate: 室友
co-worker: 同事
解析：女士提到與 Becky 合租公寓多年（sharing an apartment），住在一起即代表是室友關係，因此答案選D。選項A的鄰居、B的同事與C的表姊妹皆與同住一室的語意不符，屬於無中生有的身分干擾選項。

questions.stem: W: General, one more question. Face the camera, please. Do you think your enemy will use any chemical weapons against you? M: Very likely. But we already have countermeasures. Q: Who is the woman most likely to be?

turns.t: General, one more question. Face the camera, please. Do you think your enemy will use any chemical weapons against you?
Very likely. But we already have countermeasures.
Who is the woman most likely to be?

questions.explain:
face the camera: 面對鏡頭
countermeasure: 對策、反制手段
解析：女士稱呼對方為將軍，並請他「面對鏡頭」回答提問，明顯是在進行新聞採訪，故答案選C。選項A女兵不符記者提問的語境；選項B化學老師與D武器專家則是受到對話中 chemical weapons（化學武器）一詞誤導的字面陷阱。

questions.stem: W: You do not look yourself today. What's wrong with you? M: I didn't sleep a wink last night. Q: What does the man mean?

options.A: He has suffered from insomnia for a week
options.B: He didn't get any sleep last night.
options.C: He has been too busy for a week.
options.D: He didn't take sleeping pills last night.

turns.t: You do not look yourself today. What's wrong with you?
I didn't sleep a wink last night.
What does the man mean?

questions.explain:
not look oneself: 看起來氣色不佳
not sleep a wink: 徹夜未眠、完全沒睡
解析：男士說 didn't sleep a wink 表示昨晚根本沒睡，故答案選B。選項A與C利用 a week 與 wink 發音相近製造時間陷阱；選項D提到安眠藥則是題幹未提及的過度推論。

questions.stem: W: I've been trying to find a used car I can afford. M: Steve wants to sell his car. Maybe you should call him. W: That's a good idea. Q: Why should the woman call Steve?

options.C: He wants to buy a car.
options.D: He wants to sell a car.

turns.t: I've been trying to find a used car I can afford.
Steve wants to sell his car. Maybe you should call him.
That's a good idea.
Why should the woman call Steve?

questions.explain:
used car: 二手車
afford: 負擔得起
car dealer: 汽車經銷商
解析：女士想買負擔得起的二手車，男士告知 Steve 想賣車並建議打給他，故答案選D。選項C用 buy 取代 sell，是常見的動作反向陷阱；選項A的車商與選項B的優良駕駛在對話中均未提及。

questions.stem: M: Hi, Judy. You look great and you've really slimmed down. What have you done? W: I've been working out at a gym for a while. M: I see. Q: What does the woman mean?

options.A: She has been working late recently.
options.B: She has been on a diet for a while.
options.C: She has done a lot of physical exercise.
options.D: She has done a lot of research.

turns.t: Hi, Judy. You look great and you've really slimmed down. What have you done?
I've been working out at a gym for a while.
I see.
What does the woman mean?

questions.explain:
slim down: 變苗條、減重
work out: 運動、健身
gym: 健身房
解析：男士稱讚女士變苗條，女士回答她一直在健身房運動。work out at a gym 意指做體能運動，故答案選C。選項A利用 working 設下加班的字面聽力陷阱；B節食與D研究在對話中皆未提及。

questions.stem: W: How did you break your leg? M: I fell on a hillside while I was hiking in the mountains. Q: How did the man break his leg?

options.C: He was hit by a falling stone.

turns.t: How did you break your leg?
I fell on a hillside while I was hiking in the mountains.
How did the man break his leg?

questions.explain:
hillside: 山坡
hike: 健行
解析：女子詢問男子腿如何骨折，男子回答在登山健行時摔倒在山坡上。選項B的跌落山丘符合對話內容，故答案選B。選項C利用 fell 與 falling 的發音及字面相似設下陷阱；選項A跑馬拉松與D跳入湖中則完全未在對話中提及。

questions.stem: M: Do you have any religious beliefs? W: Of course I do. I'm a Buddhist. Q: What religion does the woman believe in?

turns.t: Do you have any religious beliefs?
Of course I do. I'm a Buddhist.
What religion does the woman believe in?

questions.explain:
religious belief: 宗教信仰
Buddhist: 佛教徒
Buddhism: 佛教
解析：男士詢問女士是否有宗教信仰，女士回答自己是佛教徒。題目問女士信仰何種宗教，其名詞形式為 Buddhism，因此答案選A。選項 B 基督教與 C 伊斯蘭教皆非對話提及的宗教；女士明確表示有信仰，故 D 也是錯誤干擾項。

questions.stem: M: Don't you hate TV commercials? W: I don't watch much TV, so they are quite interesting to me. Q: How does the woman feel about the TV commercials?

turns.t: Don't you hate TV commercials?
I don't watch much TV, so they are quite interesting to me.
How does the woman feel about the TV commercials?

questions.explain:
commercial: 電視廣告
interesting: 有趣的
解析：男士問是否討厭廣告，女士表示很少看電視所以覺得廣告相當有趣（quite interesting），與A的fun to watch意思相近，故答案選A。干擾選項B（無聊）與女士感受相反，C（太吵）與D（有教育意義）則是對話中未提及的資訊。

questions.stem: M: The pizza is really delicious. Would you like to have any more? W: No, thanks. I can't eat another bite. Q: What does the woman mean?

options.D: She wants to eat something else.

turns.t: The pizza is really delicious. Would you like to have any more?
No, thanks. I can't eat another bite.
What does the woman mean?

questions.explain:
delicious: 美味的
can't eat another bite: 吃不下了、飽了
解析：男士詢問要不要多吃一點披薩，女士回答「一口也吃不下了」，表示她已經吃飽了，故答案選A。選項B說不喜歡披薩與對話情境不符，選項C說仍然很餓則與語意完全相反，選項D說想吃別的東西亦屬過度推論的干擾選項。

questions.stem: W: I wish I had brought my umbrella. It's raining cats and dogs! M: Here. Take mine. I have a raincoat in my office room. I'll go get it. W: Thanks a lot. Q: Why doesn't the man need the umbrella?

options.B: He has a raincoat on standby.
options.D: He will remain in the office.

turns.t: I wish I had brought my umbrella. It's raining cats and dogs!
Here. Take mine. I have a raincoat in my office room. I'll go get it.
Thanks a lot.
Why doesn't the man need the umbrella?

questions.explain:
rain cats and dogs: 下傾盆大雨
on standby: 備用、待命
let up: 雨勢趨緩
解析：男士表示辦公室有雨衣可拿，因此不需要雨傘，答案選B。干擾項A雨停了與C雨勢變小皆與對話中下暴雨的現狀不符；D留在辦公室則是扭曲文意，他只是進辦公室拿雨衣而非不外出。

questions.stem: All the planes were _______ this morning because of heavy thunderstorms.
questions.explain: grounded為ground過去式及過去分詞,為“著地”

questions.stem: Because the riot was getting out of control, the police _______ called in to disperse the crowds.
questions.explain: the police為“警方”,為集合名詞,當複數用;被叫去驅散人群,故使用被動式

questions.stem: Eric felt _______ because Amy stood him up again last night.
questions.explain: stood + 人 + up為“放某人鴿子”,所以覺得depressed難過

questions.stem: We enjoyed the opera from start to _______.
questions.explain: from start to finish為“從頭到尾”

questions.stem: Mr. Tanaka is unable to make himself _______ in English; his English is too poor.
questions.explain:
人make他人understand,後面的understand使用p.p.—understood,過去分詞意
旨讓自己被人聽懂他說的英文

questions.stem: We must do something to stop the rumors. Our company's reputation is _______.
questions.explain: at risk為“陷入危險”, at ease稍息, at hand即將到來或在手邊,at will隨意

questions.stem: Three months after the surgery, Henry still had difficulty _______.
questions.explain: have difficulty為“有困難”後面動詞要加ing

questions.stem: According to her parents, Elizabeth is the most intelligent _______ the three sisters.
questions.explain: the most + adj.形容詞為最高級形容詞,後三個之中的最…之介系詞用of

questions.stem: You don't mind my smoking in here, _______?
questions.explain: 附加問句用法,前面句子否定,附加問句使用肯定,反之亦然

questions.stem: _______ pork, Sarah eats all kinds of meat.
questions.explain: apart from為“除了….之外”,同aside from, in addition to, besides, except

questions.stem: Some people are spending money _______ there is no tomorrow.
questions.explain: as if為“如同”, “好像”

questions.explain: couldn't be more different為“沒有甚麼不同”

questions.stem: Since I last saw Alice, many strange things _______ to her.
questions.explain: since為“自從”, 後面之主要句子常使用現在完成式表達“自…以來已經…..”

questions.explain: board of directors為“董事會”

questions.explain: neither為“兩者皆非”

questions.explain: 此句為諺語,天無絕人之路

questions.explain: inhabit為“棲息”,”居住於”

questions.explain: make使役動詞,後面接原形動詞

questions.stem: Avian flu (or bird flu) is a virus specific to birds. It causes flu-like symptoms in birds, and it can sometimes pass from birds to humans. There are actually many different kinds of flu viruses, and some only affect certain animals. The bird flu H5N1 is considered very dangerous because it passes so quickly from one bird to another, and it has killed millions of birds worldwide. It can also pass from an infected bird to a human. It killed over 300 people in its last outbreak, and made many more sick. Luckily, the H5N1 virus can't pass from one person to another. Recently, however, there has been a new outbreak of H7N9, another version of the bird flu virus. Again, this virus can't travel from person to person, but doctors are worried that the virus will someday be able to infect more people, which could be a huge disaster. Why isn't the bird flu as dangerous to people as it is to birds?

options.A: It passes from bird to bird very easily.
options.B: It can't pass from person to person.
options.C: It can sometimes pass from birds to humans.

questions.explain:
pass from A to B: 從A傳播到B
outbreak: 爆發
infect: 傳染、感染
解析：題目問為何禽流感對人類不像對鳥類那麼危險。文中明確指出該病毒無法在人與人間傳播，故答案選B。選項A是說明對鳥類的危險性；C與D雖皆符合課文細節，但呈現的是對人類已造成的危害，與題目問「為何沒那麼危險」相反，為反向干擾。

questions.stem: Margaret Thatcher, also known as the Iron Lady, lived from 1925 until 2013. She was a remarkable person in many ways. Thatcher was the first woman to lead a major political party in the United Kingdom. She was also the first and only woman to serve as the Prime Minister of England. She earned her nickname of Iron Lady by being a tough politician who wouldn't compromise. She believed in relaxing laws controlling business and banking as well as reducing the government's role in business. Thatcher brought up strong emotions in people: many loved her and many hated her. While her decisions definitely helped the United Kingdom in the short term, many also believe that she damaged the economy in the long term by giving businesses too much power. However she is remembered, though, she will be remembered for a long time to come as a very powerful woman. Why is Margaret Thatcher called "The Iron Lady?"

options.B: She was the first female Prime Minister.
options.D: Many people loved her, and many people hated her.

questions.explain:
Iron Lady: 鐵娘子
compromise: 妥協、讓步
tough: 強硬的、堅韌的
解析：題目詢問柴契爾夫人被稱為鐵娘子的原因。文中指出她是作風強硬且不輕易妥協（wouldn't compromise）的政治家，對應不輕言放棄，故答案選C。選項B是首位女首相、D毀譽參半雖為文中事實，但非獲得此綽號的原因；A常運動則是針對Iron的字面無關干擾。

questions.stem: Tattoos were often seen on sailors, criminals or gangsters. But now tattoos are not just connected with people with something to prove. In fact, getting tattoos is becoming more and more popular with ordinary people. They often have pictures of their sweethearts or idols tattooed on their skin. What is the main idea of the passage?

options.A: Getting tattoos is not so popular now.
options.B: The negative view of tattoos is fading away.
options.C: People should think twice before getting a tattoo.
options.D: Many parents don't want their children to get any tattoos.

questions.explain:
criminal: 罪犯
gangster: 幫派分子
fade away: 逐漸消逝
解析：文章指出刺青以往常與黑道罪犯連結，如今在一般大眾間日益普及，說明對刺青的負面觀感正逐漸淡化，故答案選B。選項A稱刺青已不流行與文意相反；選項C勸人刺青前三思以及選項D提及父母反對，皆屬於文章未提及的延伸干擾選項。

questions.stem: The lobster looks so strange and hostile that it's surprising anyone first had the nerve to try to eat it. Looking like a large insect, the lobster is actually a cousin of the spider. It has eight legs covered with tiny hairs that detect sounds and smells. When sensing danger, the lobster runs backward. According to the passage, the lobster _______ when sensing danger.
questions.explain:
retreat: 撤退、後退
hostile: 懷有敵意的
run backward: 向後跑
解析：本題問龍蝦察覺危險時的動作。文章指出龍蝦遇到危險時會「runs backward（向後跑）」，意思同義轉換即為後退或撤退，故答案選A。干擾項B（攻擊）與向後跑完全相反；C（自己跟自己打架）與D（躲藏）則是文章完全未提及的字面干擾陷阱。

questions.stem: When most people think of deserts, they are hot, dry, sandy places. In truth, deserts only need to be dry. A desert is defined as a place that gets less than 25cm of rain per year. Some deserts are actually quite cold. The Gobi desert in northern Asia often has a little snow in the winter, and its temperature can change by as much as 25 degrees Celsius in a single day. The Atacama desert in South America can also get some snow in the winter, and its temperature can change by 40 degrees Celsius or more in a single day. It shouldn't be surprising then that one of the driest places on Earth is also one of the coldest: Antarctica. This cold continent is mostly desert, even though it's covered in ice. It's just that the ice has been there a very long time, in many cases thousands of years. According to this passage, what is true about deserts?

options.A: They are always hot, dry, and sandy.
options.B: They are always hot and dry.
options.C: They are always cold and dry.

questions.explain:
desert: 沙漠
define: 定義
continent: 大陸、洲
解析：題意詢問關於沙漠何者敘述正確。文中明確提到「deserts only need to be dry（沙漠只需乾燥）」，且舉例南極等沙漠非常寒冷，可知沙漠不一定炎熱或多沙，但必定乾燥，故答案選D。干擾選項A、B加入hot（炎熱）及C加入cold（寒冷），皆屬於片面特徵且用always過度概括，為字面陷阱。
